entities.name: T3448 value
entities.description: Information element containing the value for timer T3448, used in congestion control for transport of user data via the control plane.

entities.name: Timer T3448
entities.description: Timer used in congestion control procedures for transport of user data via the control plane.

entities.name: Congestion control for transport of user data via the control plane is active
entities.description: Condition indicating that congestion control mechanisms for user data transport via control plane are currently active.

entities.name: UE supports timer T3448
entities.description: Condition indicating that the UE has capability to support timer T3448 operations.

relations.description: The T3448 value IE contains the timer value for T3448.
Inclusion of T3448 value IE is conditional upon congestion control being active.
Inclusion of T3448 value IE is conditional upon UE supporting timer T3448.
